exposure: Timing of GDM screening (routine vs. early)
outcome: Proportion of GDM diagnosed before 24 weeks' gestation
Average monthly rate of GDM diagnosis
cohort: 576 singleton pregnancies with GDM delivering at Royal Infirmary Edinburgh, UK
finding: Early screening for GDM increased the proportion of women diagnosed before 24 weeks' gestation and improved the composite outcome of emergency caesarean section, neonatal hypoglycemia, and macrosomia.
mod_finding: Early screening for GDM did not significantly change the pharmacological management of GDM.
